title: Tech Note: Managing web content for multiple languages
author: Vance Villanueva, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The general technique — using cookies plus the Accept-Language header inside a 4D Web Server's On Web Connection method to serve localized web pages — remains a technically valid, framework-agnostic pattern that still works today, though most modern web internationalization is now handled by client-side frameworks or dedicated i18n libraries rather than manual On Web Connection routing.
related_updates: Modern web apps built on 4D increasingly serve a JS/SPA frontend where i18n is handled client-side (e.g. Angular/React i18n libraries) rather than server-side cookie routing
4D's web server and On Web Connection mechanism are still available and functionally similar today
